remarks: Historic just renovated Rufus Wakeman home is strategically located in Westport, CT on a beautiful, level, professionally landscaped, and private 0.82-acre lot. This cherished residence blends historic character with modern-day comfort. High ceilings and intricate moldings showcase the craftsmanship of a bygone era, while oversized windows flood the home with natural light. The inviting entryway features a bespoke oversized front door and the original handcrafted stairway banister. Gracious living and dining rooms with two fireplaces are complemented by a cozy den and a sun-filled home office or fifth bedroom. The kitchen, dining, and family room seamlessly flow onto the spacious patio and lush backyard, creating the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor living. All new Viking appliances adorn the beautiful, renovated kitchen. Two sets of washer/dryers are available to keep your family clean. One in basement and one on the first floor. The second floor hosts the private living quarters, featuring four spacious bedrooms designed for comfort and tranquility. This level includes three fully renovated bathrooms, thoughtfully appointed to provide convenience and privacy for family and guests alike. The large, renovated master bath has a lovely two person jacuzzi for the ultimate relaxation. Ideally located just minutes from Saugatuck Center, Great restaurants, Metro North, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport. This timeless home offers a great place to call home.
